## Workload

Kofi Asante completed 267 reads during 442 hours of grading activity. This represents an average of 0.6 reads per hour. The recorded workload provides the basis for the review of the grading service during the period under consideration. The work was assessed against the available workload information, with the hours and reads considered together rather than separately. This review confirms the reported level of activity and provides a clear record for administrative monitoring.

## Quality

The result has been recorded for follow-up through the usual quality processes. No change to the current session pattern was agreed at this review. Priya Anand completed the review and confirmed the workload and quality information recorded above.
